source_excerpt: Abhishek Sharma hits 50 off 15 balls and 100 off 35 in 3rd T20 vs New Zealand; brings up 4th T20I hundred left Abhishek Sharma brought up his fourth T20I hundred. AP AP https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/s6m8r3/article71630746.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/AP10_27_2026_000275B.jpg Kerry Marshall India's Abhishek Sharma bats during the third T20 cricket international match between New Zealand and India in Wellington, New Zealand, Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026. AP/PTI(AP10_27_2026_000275B) Abhishek Sharma smashed 113 off 38 balls, hitting nine fours and 11 sixes, for his fourth T20I century against New Zealand in Wellington. Abhishek Sharma produced a breathtaking display of power-hitting against New Zealand in the third T20I on Tuesday, smashing 113 off just 38 balls. His innings featured nine fours and 11 sixes. Abhishek reached the milestone with a top-edged four off Kyle Jamieson. He celebrated by smacking the next two balls for a six and a four before getting caught off the last ball of the 10th over. India smashes world record with 118 runs in PowerPlay against New Zealand India smashes world record with 118 runs in PowerPlay against New Zealand India scored 118 runs without losing a wicket in six overs against New Zealand in Wellington, setting a new PowerPlay record among Full Member nations. India smashes world record with 118 runs in PowerPlay against New Zealand storyline 1 The century was his fourth in T20Is, taking his career tally to 2,236 runs at a strike rate of nearly 200, underlining his ability to score at a phenomenal rate. Abhishek had earlier stitched together a sensational 133-run opening stand with Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, tearing New Zealand’s bowling attack to shreds. India eventually won the match by six wickets to take an unassailable 3-0 lead in the five-match series.
